newsitem.title: ITALY: Omnitel H1 1997 sales rise 178 percent.
newsitem.headline: Omnitel H1 1997 sales rise 178 percent.

text.p: Italian mobile phone consortium Omnitel, where Olivetti has a 35.5 percent stake, on Wednesday reported first half 1997 sales up 178 percent at 680 billion lire ($378.6 million).
An Omnitel statement added that its gross operating margin was positive to the tune of seven billion lire against a 210 billion lire loss in the comparable 1996 period.

Omnitel added that it posted a first half net loss of 172 billion lire against a 259 billion lire loss in the first half of 1996, which it said puts the company on track to achieve its aim of break-even in 1998.
Omnitel, which started its mobile phone network in Italy in December 1995, said it had 1.254 million subscribers by end-June 1997, compared with 300,000 at the end of June in 1996.
Also by end-June 1997, Omnitel's mobile phone coverage of Italy was 64 percent of territory and 90 percent of population. ($ = 1796 Italian Lire)
